title: Bakery Morning ABC
hook: Finish comes later when the structure is ready.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: warm 3D preschool bakery storybook, golden bread tones and pastel icing, clean counters, isolated baked goods

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing professional bakery stages
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: process cue -> recall beat -> target -> timeline gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a warm guitar crumb-pluck and glockenspiel display ping after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a warm guitar crumb-pluck and glockenspiel display ping after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Bakery Morning ABC a timeline from pre-dawn dough and oven work to cooling, filling, glazing and display, with foods described as outcomes of distinct processes rather than interchangeable sweets.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child watches a bakery wake in stages without operating equipment: dough rises, laminated pastry flakes, cakes cool, fillings and finishes come later.
